complete_operative_paragraph: **Relic worlds.** Shuffle the relic deck before play and keep it face down. Its back-of-deck violet converter plays the top relic during Trade. Although printed on every back, it is **one converter, at most once per turn**, not a separate activation per back. The illustrated deck converter costs four small white cubes and one **ice (snowflake-symbol) colony**. Unless specified otherwise, relics may be loaned and return at turn end like Faderan-background cards. Apply each relic's printed entry rewards, if any, when it enters from the deck, in addition to its other effects. Its ordinary economic converters use the normal Economy rules and printed inputs/outputs. The named exceptions below refer to the original sheet's reverse and the printed relic cards.
spot_check: Printed Relic World Deck reverse visibly depicts four small white cubes plus a colony with a snowflake icon, a violet Trade converter and MAX ONCE PER TURN. Current canonical paragraph agrees; former jungle wording superseded.
